preferences.title: Visual production preferences
preferences.subtitle: Choose which modalities we may use when producing your Reels.
preferences.toastSuccess: Preferences saved. New productions will use these modalities.

preferences.disclosureNote: When a professional generic avatar is enabled, scripts must disclose it is not you.
preferences.ownAvatarDisabledConsent: Authorized own avatar requires active avatar consent before it can be selected. Consent is managed separately and is not granted by saving preferences.
preferences.ownAvatarAssetsNote: You will never be asked to record video or audio. Own-avatar production uses uploaded reference assets later — not live recording.

own_avatar.label: Authorized own avatar
own_avatar.description: Reels that visually resemble you, only after you have granted avatar consent.
own_avatar.example: Example: a talking-head Reel that looks like you presenting an offer, built from uploaded reference photos or clips.

generic_avatar.label: Professional generic avatar
generic_avatar.description: A stock professional presenter that is clearly not you.
generic_avatar.example: Example: a polished talking-head Reel with a catalog presenter explaining a service.

faceless.label: Faceless video / B-roll
faceless.description: No on-camera face — product, place, and motion-led visuals with optional voice or captions.
faceless.example: Example: B-roll of your work area with captions and a short voiceover, without showing a person.

consent.title: Avatar consent
disclosureV1: By granting avatar consent, you authorize Neuralitica to generate video content that visually resembles you using uploaded reference assets — not live recording.
You confirm you have the right to authorize use of your likeness for marketing Reels produced under your account.
You may revoke this consent at any time. Revocation stops new own-avatar productions; it does not automatically remove authorized own avatar from your saved preferences until you edit them.
This disclosure version is recorded for audit when you grant consent.
consent.affirmationLabel: I have read and agree to the avatar consent disclosure above.
consent.staleAllowlistWarning: Your saved preferences still include authorized own avatar, but consent is no longer active. Remove that modality or grant consent again before saving.

confirmRevoke.message: New own-avatar productions will be blocked. Your saved preferences are not changed automatically — you may still need to edit them separately.

consent.toastGrantSuccess: Avatar consent granted. You can now enable authorized own avatar in your preferences.
consent.toastRevokeSuccess: Avatar consent revoked. New own-avatar productions are blocked.
